name: The four establishments of mindfulness (satipaṭṭhāna)
method_summary: DN 22 gives the same instruction as MN 10 (body in fourteen sections, feelings, mind, dhammas in five sections) and expands the truths in the fifth dhamma-section; it also names right mindfulness in the eightfold path as the four establishments (dn22:21). Stated fruit: final knowledge in this life or non-return with a residue, expected within seven years down to seven days (dn22:22).
